debtChanges: The C03 work package closes only the admitted finite-binary64 dense LU, Householder QR, residual solve and 2x2 spectral subset. Full public SVD factors remain explicitly deferred in the scoped decision document.
The spectral 2x2 ratio is approximate and nullable; a small residual does not establish a universal forward-error bound or exact matrix rank.
